lastCompletedStory.title: Review round 1 fix 002: address reviewer finding

nextStoryContext: US-R1-002 fixed the reviewer's stale-cross-reference finding: after this branch's US-001/US-002 (deletion of src/config/permission-mode.ts and its unread permission_mode key), `~/.config/cam/config.toml` has zero readers and zero writers anywhere in the codebase, but 3 surfaces still described it as a live per-user config surface (mirror image of the dead permission_mode knob the parent PRD set out to remove). Fixed all 3, mechanically, without touching anything else: (1) README.md:258's source-layout table row for `src/config/` now reads 'scripts/cam/project.toml reader/writer + model/effort/backend resolution' instead of naming `~/.config/cam/config.toml`. (2) src/config/models.ts's header comment (previously reworded in this diff to say project.toml and the per-user surface 'target a separate, per-user config surface', asserting a surface that no longer exists) now states plainly there is no per-user config surface and that `~/.config/cam/` holds only `retry.toml` (written/read by src/retry/config.ts, untouched by this module). (3) src/config/toml.ts's module header and `loadConfig`'s null-safe-contract docstring no longer call it 'the ~/.config/cam/config.toml reader/writer' or justify null-safety via a fresh-machine-no-~/.config/cam/ scenario; both now describe it as generic-over-path with every current caller targeting scripts/cam/project.toml, and the docstring justifies null-safety via 'fresh checkout, no scripts/cam/project.toml yet' instead. The toml.ts comment edit grew the file from 209 to 211 lines (measured via content.split('\n').length, matching the file-size gate's counting method, not wc -l); scripts/file-size-budget.json's per-file ceiling for src/config/toml.ts was raised 209->211 and a new dated note naming this story (US-R1-002, CAM-458) was prepended to the top-level _ref field, preserving all prior entries. Verified via grep across src/, README.md, docs/ that no remaining reference to `~/.config/cam/config.toml` or `CAM_CONFIG_PATH` exists anywhere outside src/retry/config.ts's retry.toml (a genuinely separate, still-live per-user surface that this finding never targeted). Note for the next story: when I started this iteration, README.md/src/config/models.ts/src/config/toml.ts and the file-size-budget.json ceiling bump were already present as uncommitted changes in the working tree (git status showed them modified/staged at session start) — the fix content and the _ref prepend text already matched this story's scope exactly, so I verified correctness (typecheck, full bun test, full bun run check:all, all green) and committed as-is rather than re-doing the work; nothing further needed reverting or redoing. scripts/cam/prd.json remains untouched/unstaged per the standing rule that the implementer never edits prd.json's passes field.
